scripts.dev: concurrently --handle-input --kill-signal SIGINT --kill-others -c "green,blue,cyan,magenta,yellow,white" -n "turbo,ucp,edi-api,edi-as2,edi-orch,edi-compute" "turbo run dev start:dev --log-order=stream" "cd core/ucp/apps/ucp-api && PYTHONPATH=src uv run uvicorn ucp_api.main:app --port 3000 --reload --env-file ../../../../.env" "cd apps/edi && make dev-api" "cd apps/edi && make dev-as2" "cd apps/edi && make dev-worker-orchestrator" "cd apps/edi && make dev-worker-compute"
scripts.start:prd: turbo run build && turbo run start
scripts.typecheck:python: failed=0; for f in $(find core apps -name 'pyproject.toml' -type f); do d=$(dirname "$f"); (cd "$d" && MYPYPATH=src uv run mypy .) || failed=1; done; exit $failed
scripts.lint:python: failed=0; for f in $(find core apps -name 'pyproject.toml' -type f); do d=$(dirname "$f"); (cd "$d" && uv run ruff check .) || failed=1; done; exit $failed
scripts.test:python: export DATABASE_URL="postgresql+asyncpg://ucp_admin:ucp_password@localhost:5432/ucp_global" SHARD_1_URL="postgresql+asyncpg://edi:edi_password@localhost:5433/edi_shard_1"; failed=0; for f in $(find core apps -name 'pyproject.toml' -type f); do d=$(dirname "$f"); (cd "$d" && { uv run pytest; ret=$?; [ $ret -eq 0 ] || [ $ret -eq 5 ]; }) || failed=1; done; exit $failed
scripts.cov:python: export DATABASE_URL="postgresql+asyncpg://ucp_admin:ucp_password@localhost:5432/ucp_global" SHARD_1_URL="postgresql+asyncpg://edi:edi_password@localhost:5433/edi_shard_1"; failed=0; for f in $(find core apps -name 'pyproject.toml' -type f); do d=$(dirname "$f"); (cd "$d" && { uv run pytest --cov; ret=$?; [ $ret -eq 0 ] || [ $ret -eq 5 ]; }) || failed=1; done; exit $failed
scripts.infra:phase3-bootstrap: docker compose up -d --wait postgres_global edi_postgres_shard_1 localstack debezium_shard_1 vault cdcproxy && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.infra-reset: pnpm infra:phase1-cleanup && pnpm infra:phase2-teardown && pnpm infra:phase3-bootstrap && pnpm infra:phase4-init-edi
scripts.ucp-reset: pnpm infra:phase1-cleanup && pnpm infra:phase2-teardown && pnpm infra:phase3-bootstrap
scripts.soft-reset: pnpm infra:phase1-cleanup && cd apps/edi && make sqs-purge
scripts.deadcode:python: failed=0; for d in core/*/packages/*/python apps/*/packages/*/python apps/*/apps/* core/*/apps/*; do if [ -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ]; then (cd "$d" && uv run vulture --exclude .venv . --min-confidence 80 && uv run deptry .) || failed=1; fi; done; exit $failed
scripts.format:python: failed=0; for f in $(find core apps -name 'pyproject.toml' -type f); do d=$(dirname "$f"); (cd "$d" && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .) || failed=1; done; exit $failed
